If changing lanes away from an authorized stopped roadside vehicle is unsafe, slow and continue cautiously at a speed safe for traffic conditions. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A72
An orange-and-red fluorescent or reflective rear triangle on animal-drawn, farm or construction equipment indicates travel below twenty-five miles per hour. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A72
A vehicle moving below traffic speed must use an available right lane or stay as close as possible to the roadway's right curb or edge. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A72
A solid yellow line may be crossed to pass a vehicle traveling below half the posted limit only with enough clear opposing-lane space and without exceeding the speed limit. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A72
Watch for tractors, combines and other farm equipment crossing roads or traveling along state highways in rural areas. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A72
Pass farm equipment cautiously without relying on its operator hearing the approaching vehicle. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A72
Farm machinery must show the slow-moving-vehicle emblem and use a flashing red light at night. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A72
Animal-drawn vehicles and horseback riders have the same roadway rights and rules as motor vehicles. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A72
Stay alert where signs warn that animal-drawn vehicles or horseback riders are likely to be present. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0072]

Confusables: an approaching emergency vehicle calls for moving right and stopping; a stopped authorized vehicle calls for a safe move away or a cautious slowdown. A slow-moving emblem is distinct from the half-limit condition for crossing a solid yellow line. Mnemonic: see, space, slow. Glossary: no-zone means a large vehicle's blind area; a slow-moving emblem identifies the stated lower-speed category.
